away.summary: The Hurricanes (17-3-3) are coming off a 7-4 win over Edmonton and are projected to start Brandon Bussi in net after Pyotr Kochetkov allowed four goals on 15 shots against the Oilers. Forward Nikolaj Ehlers is out with a lower-body injury, while Juuso Valimaki and Nicolas Deslauriers are listed as scratched. The team remains strong, leading the Metropolitan Division and sitting third in the Presidents' Trophy race.

home.summary: The Rangers (13-8-1) have won three straight and six of their past seven, sitting third in the Metropolitan Division. They continue to play without goalie Igor Shesterkin, who suffered a season-ending knee injury early in the season, and are projected to start Dylan Garand with Joonas Korpisalo as backup. Defenseman Sean Durzi is a game-time decision after missing eight games, while forward Max Sasson is set to make his Rangers debut following a trade from Vancouver.
